captions.text: Pick how your Macs share the model — or let it decide.
Adjust the split. Apply is black when it's ready.
It tells you it's reloading, Mini by Mini.
Chat is ready again in about 13 seconds.
It checks the Thunderbolt link between your Macs.

final_card.text: For the nerds: reload 8.82 s · chat ready 12.93 s

footage: Live Day 21 UI screenshots from the Caravan web Balance and Thunderbolt panels. Crops only; no text rewritten inside the screenshots. No new Apply/Load/Unload or screen recording was made for this cut. End card is typographic measured timings, not a reboot claim.
sources: docs/release-notes/day21.md: UI Apply Huihui 27/37 back to 24/40 KV16, backend Ready 8.82s, chat usable 12.93s including polling

precision: Caption 'about 13 seconds' is the rounded chat-usable time. Exact 12.93 s and backend Ready 8.82 s are on the final card. The on-screen reload banner's 'about 10 seconds' is the product estimate, left unaltered in the screenshot.
